eventType.description: Mirrors the CRM-facing domain events published by other modules — logInteraction is CRM's write path for exactly those events, never a general-purpose note field for balance data.

notes.description: Free-text, non-balance annotation only. No Money field exists anywhere in this schema, under any circumstance — enforced at spec-review, not code review.

caseId.description: Equal to the Idempotency-Key the caller sent on openCase.

status.description: Reopening a Closed case returns it to Open, not InProgress -- a reopened case restarts the workflow. See updateCase/closeCase/reopenCase for exactly which transitions each operation permits.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency token, incremented on every updateCase/closeCase/reopenCase. updateCase requires the caller's last-read version; a mismatch means someone else updated this case first, and returns 409 rather than silently overwriting their change.

slaDueAt.description: openedAt (or reopenedAt, on reopen) plus a fixed duration keyed by reasonCode -- see the CRM design note's SLA table. Recomputed on reopen; untouched by updateCase.

escalated.description: Set true by the SLA sweep (not by any caller-facing write) the first time an Open/InProgress case is observed past slaDueAt. Reset to false on reopen, alongside a freshly computed slaDueAt.

authorId.description: The CSR/system actor who wrote this note -- not itself PII (an internal identity), unlike body.

body.description: Free-text case narrative -- complaint detail, resolution summary, etc. Encrypted at rest; every read is access-logged with actor and timestamp; never included in any bulk/analytics export path. Append-only, same immutability discipline as everywhere else in this system -- a correction is a new note, never an edit of a prior one.

preferredChannel.description: Null means never explicitly set -- getCommunicationPreferences returns the conservative default (null channel, every opt-in false) rather than 404, since every party implicitly has a (unset) preference state.

doNotContact.description: Overrides every channel-level opt-in when true -- a global suppression flag, not just another channel toggle.

relationshipManagerId.description: Null means no RM currently assigned. This is a persistent, per-customer relationship -- distinct from ServiceCase.assignedTo, which is the CSR working one specific case and has no bearing on who the customer's ongoing relationship manager is.

items.description: Status only — deliberately no principal, balance, or term data. Customer360 is a CRM read model; it never surfaces Money.
